  • WHAT IS COVERED? -This plan Coverage begins when the Customer purchase the Plan for his (“Device”) and ends on completion of one year from the date of purchase of the Plan (“Plan Term”). This warranty is applicable only on new XiaoMi product purchased at Amazon.

  • HOW TO RAISE A CLAIM? - Schedule a service at your convenience from your Amazon account itself by navigating to Your Orders section in your Amazon account > go to the product order > click on Get Product Support > schedule an appointment. We use genuine spare parts & repairs carried out through MI Authorized service centres.

      Top reviews from India

      • Amit Garai
        5 out of 5 stars
        A fantastic multimedia and travel phone!!
        Reviewed in India on 15 February 2026
        Colour: Silver AshSize: 8GB+128GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        A fantastic multimedia and travel phone for those who value a massive battery and a rugged build over raw processing speed.

        Pros & Cons

        Pros:

        Insane Battery Life: The 6580mAh battery is a standout, easily lasting 2 days of moderate use. Xiaomi even guarantees 6 years of battery health (retaining 80% capacity after 1600 cycles).

        "Tank" Build: It carries extreme IP69K ratings (handling high-pressure steam/water jets) and can survive drops from up to 2.5 meters.

        Stunning Display: The 3200-nit peak brightness makes it one of the most visible screens outdoors in its price bracket.

        Detailed Main Camera: The 200MP sensor takes sharp, vibrant landscape shots in good lighting.

        Cons:

        Average Charging: At 45W, it takes about an hour to charge the massive battery—slower than many competitors.

        Middling Performance: The Dimensity 7400-Ultra handles daily tasks smoothly but struggles with high-end gaming at maximum settings.

        Storage Speed: It uses UFS 2.2 storage, which feels a bit dated for a "Pro" model in 2026.

        Secondary Cameras: The 8MP ultra-wide is just "okay" and lacks the punch of the main sensor.

        If you are someone who drops their phone often, travels frequently without a charger, or watches a lot of movies on the go, this is a top-tier choice.

        Stunning Display: The 3200-nit peak brightness makes it one of the most visible screens outdoors in its price bracket.

        Detailed Main Camera: The 200MP sensor takes sharp, vibrant landscape shots in good lighting.

        Cons:

        Average Charging: At 45W, it takes about an hour to charge the massive battery—slower than many competitors.

        Middling Performance: The Dimensity 7400-Ultra handles daily tasks smoothly but struggles with high-end gaming at maximum settings.

        Storage Speed: It uses UFS 2.2 storage, which feels a bit dated for a "Pro" model in 2026.

        Secondary Cameras: The 8MP ultra-wide is just "okay" and lacks the punch of the main sensor.

        If you are someone who drops their phone often, travels frequently without a charger, or watches a lot of movies on the go, this is a top-tier choice.
